We need to convert? Maybe we can just pass site as the coordinates we got? The tool expects site optional string? Actually parameter site?: string. Maybe we need to specify site coordinates manually. Could we use the ontop site coordinates we selected? They are Cartesian; maybe the tool will accept them? Let's try passing site as that list.
